name: Vinyl Coated Polyester
hierarchyPath: Outdoor Signs > Retractable Awnings > Vinyl Coated Polyester
description: This composite of vinyl and polyester is really light-weighted and flexible. These features make it a good choice for retractable awnings. This is not only weatherproof but also UV and mildew resistant. However, it has color limitations. You can’t have it in all colors.
